Check.description:
A grading check. Either give command/match/absent/min_success directly, or a
`template` + `params` (see LAB-AUTHORING.md).

mode.description: live = show/ping over the device console; config = regex on the running config fetched via the CML API
mode.title: Mode

match.description: Python regexes (multiline: ^ and $ match per line) that must ALL match
match.title: Match

absent.description: Python regexes that must NOT match
absent.title: Absent

min_success.description: live ping checks: minimum 'Success rate is N percent'
min_success.title: Min Success

hint.description: Shown to the student when the check fails
hint.title: Hint

Check.title: Check

Fault.description:
A predefined fault for "Break my lab": applied on top of a working (solved) lab so the student
gets a realistic trouble ticket. `config` is IOS config applied after the solution (use `no ...`
to remove lines). Optional `checks` are graded in addition to the lab checks while the fault is active.

title.description: Short name of the fault (shown after it is fixed)
title.title: Title

ticket.description: Symptom-only trouble ticket shown to the student (never the cause)
ticket.title: Ticket

device.description: Device the fault is applied to
device.title: Device

config.description: IOS config applied after the solution, e.g. 'interface %if0%\n shutdown'
config.title: Config

explanation.description: Markdown: root cause and the exact fix, shown after the fault is fixed or revealed
explanation.title: Explanation

hints.description: Progressive hints for this fault, vaguest first
hints.title: Hints

checks.description: Extra checks graded while this fault is active
checks.title: Checks

Fault.title: Fault

Node.description: A router or switch. `config` is the starting config (hostname is added automatically).

name.description: Node label/hostname: letter first, then letters/digits/_/-, max 31 chars (e.g. R1, SW1)
name.title: Name

kind.description: router -> iol-xe / iosv; switch -> ioll2-xe / iosvl2
kind.title: Kind

config.description: Starting IOS config (no hostname line needed). Use %if0%..%if3% for data interfaces
config.title: Config

definition.description: Optional explicit CML node definition instead of the platform profile's router/switch, e.g. 'nxosv9000' (NX-OS 9000v, ports 0-3 = Ethernet1/1-1/4). Write literal interface names in its config, not %ifN%
definition.title: Definition

Node.title: Node

Step.description: One step of a walkthrough lab: why, the exact config per device, how to verify it, and optional checks.

explain.description: Markdown: what this step builds and why (concepts first, concise)
explain.title: Explain

config.description: device -> exact config for this step (copy buttons in the UI)
config.title: Config

verify.description: Verification commands with the expected output
verify.title: Verify

checks.description: Checks run by 'Check this step' (live and/or config)
checks.title: Checks

optional.description: Optional step: not needed to complete the walkthrough
optional.title: Optional

apply.description: Offer 'Apply this step for me' (push the config over the console)
apply.title: Apply

Step.title: Step

Verify.description: A verification command shown in a walkthrough step, with what good output looks like.

command.description: Read-only 'show ...' or 'ping ...' command to run on the device
command.title: Command

expect.description: Markdown: what to look for in good output (a short excerpt is fine)
expect.title: Expect

Verify.title: Verify

id.description: Lowercase id: letters, digits, dashes (2-41 chars). Also the folder name
id.title: Id

type.description: challenge (default): a graded task. walkthrough: a guided build in ordered `steps` (not graded; no faults or exam mode; completion is tracked separately)
type.title: Type

task.description: Markdown task text shown to the student
task.title: Task

checks.description: Challenge labs: needs at least one live and one config check. Walkthroughs: leave empty and put the checks in the steps
checks.title: Checks

steps.description: Walkthrough labs only: the ordered steps
steps.title: Steps

ram_gb.description: Optional: CML server RAM the lab needs in GB. Default: estimated from the node definitions
ram_gb.title: Ram Gb

solution.description: Optional reference solution: device -> config lines
solution.title: Solution

solution_summary.description: Markdown shown after the lab is solved (or on 'Reveal solution'): the root cause / what was missing, the exact fix commands per device, and briefly why it works. Required for new labs; if empty the app generates a fallback from `solution`
solution_summary.title: Solution Summary

hints.description: Ordered progressive hints (vague first, most specific last), revealed one at a time with the Hint button. Never paste the full answer into a hint. If empty, the per-check hints are used in check order
hints.title: Hints

faults.description: Optional predefined faults for 'Break my lab' (random troubleshooting practice on the solved lab)
faults.title: Faults
